title: Would YOU hug a BOILING kettle? 👇 #shorts
description: Old Hissy hasn't had a hug in fifty years. Lolly wants to help. Bup says no way. Would YOU hug him? Comment YES or NO! #shorts #animation #cartoon #doughbros

beats.en: Nobody has hugged me in fifty years. Sniff.
beats.es: Nadie me ha abrazado en cincuenta años. Snif.
beats.de: Niemand hat mich seit fünfzig Jahren umarmt. Schnief.
beats.fr: Personne ne m'a serré dans ses bras depuis cinquante ans. Snif.
beats.it: Nessuno mi abbraccia da cinquant'anni. Snif.
beats.pt: Ninguém me abraça há cinquenta anos. Snif.

beats.fr: Ohh ! Moi, je vais te faire un câlin !

beats.en: Lolly, STOP! He's two hundred degrees!
beats.de: Lolly, STOPP! Er hat zweihundert Grad!
beats.fr: Lolly, ARRÊTE ! Il fait deux cents degrés !
beats.it: Lolly, FERMA! È a duecento gradi!
beats.pt: Lolly, PARA! Ele está a duzentos graus!

beats.en: Ouch! Hot hot hot! ...Still worth it.
beats.fr: Aïe ! Chaud, chaud ! ...Ça valait le coup.
beats.it: Ahia! Scotta, scotta! ...Ne valeva la pena.

beats.en: Would YOU hug Old Hissy? Comment YES or NO!
beats.es: ¿Abrazarías TÚ al Viejo Hissy? ¡Comenta SÍ o NO!
beats.de: Würdest DU den alten Hissy umarmen? Schreib JA oder NEIN!
beats.fr: Et TOI, tu ferais un câlin au Vieux Hissy ? Écris OUI ou NON !
beats.it: E TU abbracceresti il Vecchio Hissy? Scrivi SÌ o NO!
beats.pt: VOCÊ abraçaria o Velho Hissy? Comente SIM ou NÃO!
